title: Lucid Pavement
description: A dreamy beatless opening of warm pad and a glassy square arpeggio slowly gathers tension, then a 909 kit slides in piece by piece until it locks into a driving 144-bpm UK dance-pop groove. The filter peels open as the arp climbs registers, leaving an airy rhythmic pocket for a rap before the track dissolves back to its ambient bed.
